fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Rail Grid As A Perpetual Energy Machine", "body": "Michelle argues that the railroads, streetcars and subways were never transportation projects at all but parts of a perpetual energy generating system, with hot springs, the elliptical tracks now used as racetracks, and the trolley parks at the end of every line all wired into the same circuitry. Chance connects this to the electric universe idea of the whole realm as a galvanic battery, and Michelle says she would take a time machine back for a day to see a civilization she believes was abundant, harmonious, and certain of exactly where it sat in the universe."}, {"title": "Word Magic And The Real Matrix", "body": "Chance pushes back gently on the language of unplugging from the matrix, pointing out that matrix means womb and mother, so denouncing it unconsciously denounces the womb of creation we are all growing inside, when what we actually need is to plug in electrically to the real thing with bare feet on the ground. He offers the same inversion for circuit board Earth, suggesting circuit boards may be modeled on the Earth rather than the other way around. Michelle agrees that word sorcery is exactly what has been going on, and that things were not originally like that."}, {"title": "The Parasite, The Host And The Long Plan", "body": "Chance asks how a ruling class stays permanently on top when the law of nature is change, and answers that they would have to get ahead of the change and influence it, which is what the data collection and algorithm world now allows. Michelle agrees they set it up to stay in front and frame the outcome they wanted across a multigenerational plan. Chance calls the controller class parasitic upon the people and the realm, Michelle asks where that leaves them once the host is destroyed, and she names artificial intelligence and transhumanism as the intended escape hatch."}, {"title": "Peabody, Philanthropy And The Banking Houses", "body": "George Peabody, called the father of modern philanthropy, becomes the thread that unravels everything else. Michelle traces him from the Peabody Estates in London and a hidden hand portrait to his role as a British Freemasonic banker whose money reached abolitionists calling for dissolution of the union, then to JP Morgan Sr, to Riggs Bank and its later money laundering scandals, and on to Brown Brothers Harriman, Prescott Bush and Deutsche Bank. She finds the same rags to riches pattern in Freemason founders like John Molson and Joseph Seagram, both orphaned young and suddenly running whole industries."}, {"title": "Impossible Timelines And The Crystal Palace", "body": "Chance asks why anyone would go to the huge trouble of digging out canals that were obsolete the moment the railroads worked, and Michelle calls that one of the places the narrative starts to crumble. The Crystal Palace gets the same treatment, a building covering nineteen acres with its own high level railway station, conceived in 1849, opened in May of 1851 and closed that October, then supposedly taken down, moved, and burned in 1936. Chance adds that exhibition originally meant showing titles and papers before a tribunal in proof of facts."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I just see this beautiful civilization that was abundant, and people were having fun.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "In truth, we should be getting even plugged in electrically to the actual matrix, like bare feet on the ground, not the artificial matrix.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Humans are riddled with parasites and don't usually deal with their own parasites, and the controller class is parasitic upon the people and on the realm.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's a lot of wild cards out there and we're one of them, that in spite of everything, we're still waking up.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This is what's in the historical record, or hysterical record, depending on how you want to look at it.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Alcohol distills the spiritual essence from whatever it's added to in alchemy. It's why it's called spirits.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The governments and the mafias are the same thing, and they both basically exist to extort money and then launder the extorted money.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I did not know what I was going to unravel when I started looking at George Peabody, but somehow it was right there.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Why would you go through the huge trouble of digging out canals that were immediately obsolete?", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm not looking at Freemasons and saying, \"Oh, they're all in it.\" I don't believe that for a moment.", "author": "Michelle Gibson", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/e0694c15-c073-4a98-b7b4-e53efaa54f8a/MICHELLE-GIBSON.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
